players.product: high-layer-count and high-order HDI PCBs for AI servers / GPU boards, plus mSAP 800G / 1.6T optical-module PCBs

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 (annual report): operating revenue RMB 15,308,052,020.33, up 20.92% year on year, on larger capacity, more orders and higher sales; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 1,230,969,813.30, up 5.30%; net profit after non-recurring items RMB 1,021,130,865.84, down 3.15%. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 3,343,333,808.89, Q2 RMB 3,751,852,712.74, Q3 RMB 3,987,408,668.33, Q4 RMB 4,225,456,830.37; Q4 net profit attributable RMB 282,853,224.77. Financial expenses rose 229.03% mainly on exchange losses from US dollar depreciation and higher interest.

PCB main business in 2025: revenue RMB 14,372,623,355.70, up 19.92%, gross margin 16.95%, down 1.83 percentage points. Domestic sales RMB 8,678,758,794.90 (+22.92%, GM 9.69%); export sales RMB 5,693,864,560.80 (+15.63%, GM 28.01%). Output 1,267.05 ten-thousand square metres (+14.54%), sales volume 1,239.15 ten-thousand square metres (+15.15%); direct materials were 61.64% of cost.
quarterly_data.figure: PCB revenue RMB 14,372,623,355.70 (+19.92%); GM 16.95%; sales volume 1,239.15 ten-thousand square metres (+15.15%)

quarterly_data.signal: Top five customers were 25.09% of 2025 sales (RMB 36.06 hundred million); names and individual shares not disclosed.
Top five suppliers were 38.24% of 2025 purchases (RMB 33.84 hundred million); names and individual shares not disclosed.

AI infrastructure (annual report): working with a leading global AI computing infrastructure customer (unnamed) on early product development, the company reached large-scale mass production of high-end PCBs including 40+ layer HLC, 6-order 22-layer HDI, mSAP 14-layer HDI and multilayer PTFE FPC; AI server PCB products shipped at scale in 2025 after years of preparation. It supplies 800G optical-module PCBs in stable volume to several leading optical-module customers and is pushing 1.6T into volume shipment. The company says it is following cloud-server makers' ASIC development for cooperation opportunities and expects its AI server, optical-module and high-speed switch business to drive growth.

Technology (annual report): high-order HDI, Birchstream-platform high-speed PCBs, PTFE rigid-flex and high-speed FPC for data centers, AI servers, HPC and optical modules are in volume production; it passed audits by several leading server, switch and optical-module customers, started certification of 11-order HDI, and its 9-order HDI passed customer certification within 90 days. At end-2025 it could mass-process M7 to M9 grade and PTFE materials and was developing M9+ ultra-low-loss materials; pre-research covers the server OKS platform and 224G switches. R&D spend RMB 929,932,405.04 (+22.75%), 6.07% of revenue; 2,498 R&D staff.

Capacity (annual report): seven production bases - Shenzhen, Longchuan, Jishui, Xinfeng, Zhuhai Jinwan, Zhuhai Fushan and Thailand (under construction). At Zhuhai Jinwan, the base for AI server products (high-order HDI, HLC, SLP), part of the expansion lines went into production in 2025; the high-order HDI plant construction was 32.32% of its RMB 25,608.00 ten-thousand budget; the convertible-bond HDI (including SLP) project (RMB 113,961.54 ten-thousand planned, 97.03% invested) reached intended usable state in February 2026. The Ganzhou (Xinfeng) high-layer PCB base phase 1 started production in January 2025 and ramped smoothly. Zhuhai Kinwong subsidiary 2025 revenue RMB 217,380.95 ten-thousand with a net loss of RMB 10,892.69 ten-thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: Zhuhai high-order HDI plant 32.32% of RMB 25,608.00 ten-thousand budget; HDI (SLP) project usable February 2026

quarterly_data.signal: Thailand base (annual report): main structure topped out in 2025, equipment installation and customer introduction under way, and production expected to start within 2026; planned investment not more than RMB 7 hundred million; plant construction was 86.17% of its RMB 29,596.46 ten-thousand budget at end-2025.

2026 business plan (annual report): strengthen its lead in automotive PCBs, accelerate the AI data-infrastructure business as a new growth driver, release high-end capacity and raise the share of high-end products, and speed up start of production and ramp of the new Zhuhai Jinwan HDI plant and the Thailand base. The company notes supply-chain restructuring, geopolitics and raw-material prices as challenges and that these forward-looking plans are not commitments.
